name: Eleleth
source:
The girl was about to be killed by someone.
No, to be precise, it wasn’t a person.
It was a 'banana' in human form.

The young man was trying to save the girl.
No, to be precise, it wasn’t the girl he wanted to save.
He wanted to rescue himself.

And the year was 1996.

The last girl was about to kill someone.
No, to be precise, it wasn’t a person.
What she hated was one particular 'angel.'
November 13th, 6:00 AM.
Today, for the sake of her loved ones―

―――――――The girl is about to...

An ADV that is unreasonable in many a way.
It seems serious, but it’s also a gag… or is it serious after all?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5903]freem page[/url]]
